script:
---level3 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl3_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
			
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		if dialog.show("Level3-1", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("60-4")

		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(661,1395)
		if dialog.show("Level3-2", faceJingya) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level3-3", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		sound.play("58-1")
		if dialog.show("Level3-4", faceShengqi) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("57-1")
		if dialog.show("Level2-8", faceWunai,2.5) ==1 then break end

		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl3_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false
		isSkip = false
	
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end

onRoleDied = function()
    countFail = countFail + 1
    game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
    if countFail <= 1 then
		sound.play("51-2")
        dialog.show("Level1-12", faceBujie)
    else
		sound.play("58-1")
        dialog.show("Level1-13", faceShengqi)
    end
    game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
    role.loadState()
end
